column1: # Adversarial inputs for di_validate_override_url (scripts/single-node/deploy.sh).
# Format: name<TAB>value, value expanded with `printf %b`.
# See scripts/dev/shell-differential.sh for what this corpus is for.
# THIS FILE IS NOT A COPY OF THE GO TABLE. cmd/deploy_script_test.go pins the
# validator's RULES and is the authority on them. This corpus pins something the
# table is structurally bad at: inputs whose significant bytes are at the END,
# where a diff of ordinary test output shows nothing and an editor eats the
# evidence. Every row below was added BEFORE an implementation was chosen, which
# is the only reason the trailing-newline regression was caught at all.
# Ordinary values — a portability change must not alter these either.
regional Cloud Run endpoint (real default)
tokeninfo endpoint (real default)
loopback stub
localhost
ipv6 loopback
uppercase host
double userinfo
denied host
no scheme
non-http scheme
# TRAILING WHITESPACE ON THE HOST. Command substitution strips trailing
# newlines. Lowercasing runs BEFORE the host-shape assertion, so a plain
# `$(… | tr …)` deletes the byte that the assertion exists to reject: measured,
# these three flip REJECT -> ALLOW.
trailing newline on a permitted host
trailing newlines on a permitted host
trailing newline on an uppercase permitted host
trailing newline on a denied host
# TRAILING WHITESPACE INSIDE THE SCHEME. Same defect, other site: a scheme
# comparison that silently accepts "https\n". Measured: these two flip
# REJECT -> ALLOW under the plain form.
trailing newline inside the scheme
trailing newline inside an uppercase scheme
# CARRIAGE RETURN — A NEGATIVE CONTROL ON THE FIX, NOT A DUPLICATE OF THE ABOVE.
# Substitution strips newlines only, so these must be UNAFFECTED by the fix.
# They pin its blast radius: if a future rewrite starts eating \r too, it has
# over-reached and these rows say so.
trailing carriage return on a permitted host
carriage return inside the scheme
# Interior control characters — not stripped by substitution, rejected by the
# host-shape assertion. Present so a rewrite cannot quietly change WHICH rule
# rejects them, which is a diagnostic change even when the verdict holds.
space in the host
tab in the host
newline in the host
carriage return in the host
